## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Identify whether this
affects Blender, a worker, node assets, or a research-only model.

## Validation

List the checks actually run, their environment and any remaining limitations.
For node changes include the reviewed contract diff and Blender package check.
For physics changes identify the native baseline, independent reference,
uncertainty and regression results.

## Reproduction

Link the relevant documentation or study. Identify new dependencies, required
inputs, runtime profile changes or migrations.
